assumptions: Caller contract: allocation is a lane prefix within LSQ readiness and four-slot ROB space; kinds are exclusive; retirement is a lane prefix in ROB order and a store retires only with address and data; flush and recovery exclude each other and exclude allocation and retirement; recovery keeps a live slot; load take only with offer.

Address updates carry a legal aligned size, as load_store_prepare guarantees. Identities, values, masks, early flags, committed owner and memory word are otherwise unconstrained, including stale identities.
environment: Independent reference ROB window (four slots, two generation bits) records kind, identity, and resolved address/data per slot from the same input events.

Load offer, identity, masks, forwarded bytes and extended result are computed by an oldest-first, youngest-older-store search in ROB order. DUT ranks, pointers and selector outputs are never used by the reference.
